summary: Refactored packages/protocol from a single large index.ts into a 13-line compatibility barrel backed by cohesive schema modules (core, envelopes, errors, events, extensions, git, parsers, projects, providers, sessions) and grouped request variants under src/requests/. Tests were split into protocol.test.ts and project-resources.test.ts. Verification: pnpm check and prettier --write/--check passed, 2 test files / 15 tests passed, and all 135 original barrel exports match with identical serialized schema hashes (protocolVersion stays 25).
